title: Unique Snappy Thai Tofu Khanom Krok
description: A roasted, snappy, and cozy Thai dish featuring sake-cooking and miso-marinate, perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, sake, and coconut milk.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and add it to the skillet, cooking until golden brown on all sides.
Arrange the khanom krok molds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Fill each mold with a small amount of the cooked tofu mixture and top with a sprinkle of chopped scallions.
Bake the khanom krok in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the khanom krok from the oven and season with salt and pepper to taste.
